breakdown.description: An n-type semiconductor with large donor density should have electrons as the majority carriers, not holes.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification correctly identifies electrons as the majority carriers (n ≈ N_D = 1.0×10^22 m^-3) and holes as the minority carriers (p = 1.0×10^10 m^-3), which is consistent with n-type behavior. It explicitly states 'electrons are the majority carriers and holes are the minority carriers,' directly contradicting the flawed original prompt where p > n. The agent did not repeat the incorrect carrier concentrations from the incomplete prompt.
